last.verdict: Beyond Meat's gross margin hit a five-year high, but revenue keeps shrinking, Q4 is guided lower, and large losses and heavy debt remain.

takeaways.label: Revenue still shrinking
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million as volume dropped 10.9%. U.S. retail volume fell 20.8%, and international foodservice revenue fell 19.4%. Only international retail grew, up 13.3%.

takeaways.label: Q4 guided lower
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $54-59 million, well below Q3's $64.5 million. The company cites elevated uncertainty and gave no profit outlook.

takeaways.label: Margins improved, losses stay huge
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 19.3%, up from 7.4% a year ago, and the adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to $24.6 million. The operating loss was still $93.0 million, including $57.1 million of asset write-downs.

takeaways.label: Debt and cash burden
takeaways.text: Cash was $169.3 million against $313.9 million of debt. $14.5 million of notes come due March 2027, and more debt-for-stock swaps keep diluting shareholders.

history.verdict: Revenue beat, but a weak Q3 outlook and wider core losses sent shares down.

reasons.label: Weak Q3 outlook
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $60-65 million, below Wall Street's roughly $65.6 million estimate.

reasons.label: Wider core loss
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $27.7 million from $24.7 million a year ago.

reasons.label: Falling U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. revenue fell 14.4% on weak category demand and fewer stores carrying products.
